relationships.subject: Reg3β
relationships.evidence_quote: Reg3b-specific knockdown in DRG neurons substantially reduced macrophage accumulation in DRG of CPIP model rats

relationships.subject: macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that infiltrated macrophages produce TNF-α in DRG of CPIP model rats.

relationships.subject: TNF-α
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α promotes Reg3β overexpression and secretion from DRG neurons via TNFR1/STAT3-dependent mechanism

relationships.subject: TNF-α
relationships.evidence_quote: the hyperexcitability of DRG neurons from CPIP model rats was caused by increased activity of TRPV1 mediated by TNF-α signaling

key_findings: Neuronal Reg3β recruits M1-like macrophages to DRG; macrophage TNF-α drives Reg3β via TNFR1/STAT3, forming a positive feedback loop in CRPS-I rats.
TNF-α blockade with etanercept reduced DRG neuron hyperexcitability and TRPV1 currents.
